promise_to_preserve.statement: Existing database rows and new or edited tasks remain readable, and the sfx reader is verified from loaded code after ordinary landing and update.

obligation.state_required_before_amendment: structured open predicate with met:false in the current root acceptance_results.open

proposed_delivery_declarations.command_purpose: Run after ordinary landing and reader update against the running sfx service; the private case file and prior health values are supplied outside Git. The command must exit successfully and write a fresh sanitized receipt.

preservation_requirements: Keep the P3 statement, kind and check_protocol exactly as already promised.
Keep every accepted product command, required artifact, blocked pattern, command encoding, and list order; add only the accepted delivery check through the native contract path.
Keep the ordinary gate before publication; SKIPPED does not mean PASS.
Keep other open obligations and all DONE child provenance unchanged.
Split the existing mixed root evidence into product and delivery identities through an authorized native contract revision; do not classify its current mixed prose as delivery-only.
Keep global acceptance_results.passed false while P3 remains open; close P3 only after actual postpublication delivery verification.

current_journal_observation.existing_root_evidence: one mixed external_review item in current typed_contract.json; not a delivery selector

read_before_addressed_amend_completion: Current owner incarnation, obligation epoch, request identity and current answered status from the native root operator-request path.
Entire current root acceptance_results.open.P3 object, including canonical promise and complete verification; require a structured object, exact P3 promise and met:false.
Entire current root acceptance.json accepted contract: acceptance commands, command_encoding presence and value, required_artifacts, blocked_patterns and list order.
Entire current root typed_contract.json evidence_of_completion list after the authorized product/delivery split; select the complete delivery-only list exactly.
Entire current root typed_contract.json completion_contract field, including null/absent versus object, for the exact from value.
Current accepted delivery command bytes or receipt target and corresponding selector type from P3 verification; do not substitute this proposal for accepted values.
Current publication ref, explicit external-effect authority, retained product candidate, gate result, open obligations and DONE child provenance from native acceptance before product admission.
consumption_rule: Only a current, addressed operator answer containing one complete AMEND_COMPLETION from/to line can apply this declaration through the native consumer. This file is neither an operator answer nor acceptance, publication, or live delivery evidence.
